data.name: Kairavi
data.gender_notes: Kairavi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kairavi is a beautiful Sanskrit name derived from the Goddess Kaira, who is revered for her unparalleled beauty and wealth. The name is a symbol of grace and prosperity. The name Kairavi carries the meaning “Goddess of beauty and wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kairavi usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of beauty and wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Kairavi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of beauty and wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kairavi total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kairavi holds significant cultural importance in Hinduism, as it is derived from Goddess Kaira, who is denoted as the goddess of beauty, wealth, and abundance. It is believed that naming a child Kairavi would bestow upon them the blessings of the Goddess, thus ensuring prosperity and good fortune for the future.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Kairavi signifies the inner radiance and beauty of the soul. It serves as a reminder to always strive towards cultivating grace, humility, and inner richness, as these qualities are considered essential traits of an enlightened being. The name Kairavi also signifies the deep connection between the divine and the human realm, emphasizing the importance of seeking spiritual guidance and inspiration from the divine.
